verdict.rationale: Langfuse docs explicitly describe automatically scoring live production traces via LLM-as-a-Judge and Scores API/SDK, plus code evaluators for deterministic checks and alerting when metrics cross thresholds — directly matching continuous evaluation on live traffic, not just offline datasets. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that continuous production scoring works reliably at scale, and more detail on how evaluators are scheduled/triggered continuously.
